title: foundations
purpose: Defines visual/semantic token foundations and scale governance.
when: When creating/refactoring primitives, semantic tokens, naming, and scales.

title: components
purpose: Designs reusable component API contracts and behavior models.
when: When specifying variants, states, slots, and implementation handoff.

title: theming
purpose: Defines multi-theme and multi-brand semantic mapping discipline.

title: accessibility
purpose: Governs accessibility across tokens, components, themes, and docs.
when: When validating keyboard, focus, screen reader, contrast, and motion behavior.

title: documentation
purpose: Defines documentation architecture and usage/migration communication.
when: When writing system docs, do/do-not-use rules, and change communication.

title: governance
purpose: Defines contribution, ownership, RFC, release, and exception policy.
when: When operating sustainable cross-team system governance.

title: review-audit
purpose: Audits compliance, scores risk, and drives remediation backlogs.
when: When running product or library conformance reviews.

title: framework-mapping
purpose: Maps semantic intent to CSS variables/Tailwind/CSS Modules/CSS-in-JS.
when: When implementing system contracts across frontend frameworks.

title: design-token-governance
purpose: Governs token lifecycle from proposal through release and migration safety.
when: When token changes require classification, compatibility checks, CI gates, and deprecation control.

title: system-adoption-playbook
purpose: Guides organizational design-system rollout, enablement, and adoption governance.
when: When coordinating migration waves, training, metrics, and exceptions across product teams.
